entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Joon Testigo. Julat jalte coleson yuun yaj navat a va yoc yash ochat ta cotan. Joon testigo viti ayoti, joon mayuc yhipal y jahat yhipaál mayuc vin hay cuun y jalat a culejal. Mayuc van ctohone ayoti bi y nash jahat, jahat asocitayvotic vin ayotic ta coleson.
